title: Congressional Research Service UFO study for Carter with Sheehan as special counsel
summary: Dan Sheehan tells of Congressional Research Service UFO study for Carter with Sheehan as special counsel, about 1977 at Washington, D.C., and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: he asked the uh Congressional uh Science and Technology committee to to contact the the uh Congressional research service and have them do a special uh research project for him on what all the information was that our United States government had uh about the UFO phenomena

plain: Dan Sheehan is a lawyer who says he was involved in a UFO study in 1977. He tells podcast host Jesse Michels that President Jimmy Carter asked the House science and technology committee to have the Congressional Research Service, the research arm of Congress based at the Library of Congress in Washington, do a special project on everything the US government knew about UFOs. Sheehan says he served as special counsel on it and names a woman called Marcia Smith in connection with it, which would mean a president himself went looking for the government's UFO files.
